description: AdvanVis - FlareScope Flare Stack Monitor turns flare readings into a live flare stack. The flame grows with the flare gas flow, the alarm bands run up the stack, and the header says at a glance whether a flare is normal, in alarm, smoking or losing its pilots, with the trend, events, totals and a replay of the period underneath. WHAT IT SHOWS • Flame height from the flow: linear, square root, logarithmic, or the flame-length relation flare design uses (length grows with heat release to the power 0.478) • Alarm bands on the stack: low-low, low, normal, high and high-high, from the Format pane or from your own limit fields per flare and per reading, with a deadband so a flow on a limit does not chatter • Status at a glance: the band, the flow and its change, with flags for pilots, smoke, a rising flow, stale data and over range • Readouts: percent of design capacity, time in band, time to high-high at the current rate, trend per hour, smokeless margin, pilots, events, total flared and CO2e, peak, wind and heat zone distance • Trend with the bands, limit lines (stepped when limits change), numbered flaring events and data gaps • Replay: play, drag or use the keys to see the flame, the strip and the readouts at any moment, or open on a chosen moment for an incident review • Events: every run in high or high-high, with its duration, peak and volume • Pilots lit or out: a pilot-out…
